name: Verify citation identity before evaluating claim support
evidence: The authors checked title/author matches through multiple databases and publisher records, then assessed bibliographic errors.

operational_primitive.transformation: First resolve source identity and metadata; then read the relevant passage against the bounded claim.

constraints: The semantic second stage is a transfer hypothesis, not an evaluated component of the Walters audit.
reuse_hypothesis: Keep bibliography correction separate from scientific evidence checking to prevent a real DOI being treated as sufficient support.
next_test: Audit five existing key claims for both identity and passage support, retaining unsupported scope expansions.
word_count_convention: Whitespace-separated tokens in recursive string values; excludes word_count and this convention; excludes JSON keys.
